description:
`just moonlander` failed in scripts/generate-keymap with:

  Error: nu::shell::cant_convert
  can't convert record<_ARROWS: list<string>, _BASE: ...> to cell-path

Cause: in nushell `$in` rebinds at every pipe. Inside

  each { $keymap.layers | get $in }

the `$keymap.layers |` starts a new pipeline, so `$in` at `get` is the
layers *record*, not the layer name from the closure's input.

Fix: name the closure parameter.

  each {|name| $keymap.layers | get $name }

Findings worth keeping:

- The reported outer error pointed at line 10 (`columns`), not line 15
  where the failure was. Nushell attributes an error's "source value"
  span to where the value was *created*; the layer-name strings come
  from `columns` on line 10. Red herring - read the inner error first.

- xbows never hit this. `keymap_generated.c` is committed for xbows and
  `*peterhoeg*.json` is gitignored, so make only runs the script on a
  first fresh generation. Moonlander was the first.

- Verified in-container: transform yields 6 layers, _BASE first, 72 keys
  each. The trailing `qmk json2c` and `qmkfmt` steps could not be run
  (neither is on PATH in the container) but are untouched by the fix.

Landed in 2ba8b52 "fix: keymap generator".
title: generate-keymap: $in rebinds at every pipe, breaking layer lookup
